Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		rep: Repair = Repair.allInstance()->any(r|r.Id = rid),
		stf: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = sid)
	precondition:
		rep.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		stf.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let ah: ApprovalHistory in
		ah.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalHistory.allInstance()->includes(ah) and
		rep.History->includes(ah) and
		ah.StaffId = stf.Id and
		ah.Reject = reject and
		ah.Suggestion = suggestion and
		if reject 
		then rep.Process = 5 
		else if rep.Process = 0 and
		stf.Role = 1 
		then rep.Process = 1 
		else if rep.Process = 1 and
		stf.Role = 2 
		then rep.Process = 2 
		else if rep.Process = 2 and
		stf.Role = 3 
		then rep.Process = 3 
		else rep.Process = rep.Process 
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  and
		result = ah
}
